Elitism No reflection on authors capabilities. Just had a hard time in this year of 2020, to read of the excesses of the ultimate richest people with out sensing the world outside.
Perhaps the book ultimately balances this, but I didn’t last through the first chapter.
Tedious! The title of the review says it all.  If you need a good night's sleep, this book will help you acquire one.
Really nice. This is a classic story with such wonderful charachters. They really did a great job getting you to fall in love with all the characters. Marvelous.

Great tale Almost put it down after I started reading. Couldn't figure out where it was going and then it really picked up! I was hooked! It was hard to put down.

Deinitely on to the next book!

Great Intro to Clayton Graham Great collection of short stories that will quickly get you hooked on Clayton Graham.  I follow him on Facebook and receive his newsletter, the latter of which usually includes a short story, too.  This collection reminds me of the stories collected in the old Twilight Zone Magazine that my mom used to subscribe to.  Each tale is unique.  You'll find a bit of mystery, thriller, paranormal and sci-fi.  Grab this book while you can and delve into the world that is Cla
Good concept but a little confusing I liked the idea of the story but had a hard time keeping up with all the people concerned. But will plod on.  Hoping it will clear up a little

More baseball; less personal life than Leavy's "Big Fella" Well done, probably more of the Babe's baseball life than Jane Leavy's "Big Fella." Pretty darn good. I like that at the beginning he states "This book is not for kids."

NUMA at work Another thought provoking Clive Cussler book, gets one thinking about the changes in our world.. about our thoughtless use of water and air. Makes one work at recycling. Got me on the waiting list for Cusslers latest book in large print at the library.
WOW, So freaking Hot This is epic Love. And is so sexy and the sex is just WOW.  I can't wait to read the next book.

This book was fitting for Trumps authoritarian rule in process ... This book was fitting for Trumps authoritarian rule in process today.  I see Trumps wall as the Krakow' Wall in the Ghetto.  For me, America is in grave danger of losing human rights on a massive scale.  It's time for Civil War in America to protect the lives of the immigrants!

Enjoyable enough This story tells the tale of a troubled family. The teller is the niece of a man who had his own serious trouble who searched throughout his life to find his place in the world. When it seemed that he found himself, his life was taken, leaving behind more questions than answers. The niece never knew her uncle until she began her search to find out why her life was as mysterious as his.

Not a Clean Romance Interesting setting:  drought-induced fire sweeps through the woman's neighborhood.  Her property is targeted for potential flooding control by the authorities.  That's where the love interest comes in.  But it's not long before there's attention drawn to intimate details.

A very good read. Very well written story of a father's role in the life of an addicted son. I had read the son's story some years ago and happened to purchase this book without realizing the connection. It was interesting to hear the father tell the same story from his point of view. A very good read.

I like character development ... But within a short time of reading I was painfully aware of the author's informing of this or that character's mannerisms and their import. And often a passage was heavily burdened with historical info which became droning in my mind. Wasn't my cup of tea. Sorry!
Expecting To Die As usual this book keeps your total attention all the way to the end. Or is it the end? Just keep looking for the next one in the series
Loved It! This was my first book by this author, and it was beautiful.  I loved the writing style and felt for all of the characters.  Could not put it down.  Great read.

This book contains useful information and it is available for free from Amazon. This book contains useful information and it is available for free from Amazon. The prudent person would be wise to store up as much of this information as possible while it is readily available at no cost.
Nice story This was a good story with drama and romance. Gruesome at times but with the happy ending I always like.

A sweet story... This story reads like a classic fairy tale. The prose is reminiscent of some of the old stories and easy to read. It is told from various character viewpoints, which is not my favorite way to read a book, but it works fairly well. Overall, I really enjoyed this story; it is sweet and satisfying.

A GOOD read! Michael Grumley has written a good, fun, interesting story. The first part, the build up, is interesting. He does a great job of moving between events that are occurring simultaneously. There are many 'cliffhanger' moments. Towards the middle and end it was hard to put down, and just a really good read. Not going to give details. Just read it and have a good time.

Keller's Designated Hitter Keller's Designated Hitter, Keller the Dog Killer, Keller’s Adjustment and Quotidian Keller are all stories that are a part of Hit Parade, which has many more Keller stories as well. I’d recommend getting Hit Parade instead.

[[ASIN:B000JMKO2I Hit Parade (Keller series Book 3)]].

I absolutely love this series. I dunno, between Komi and Manbagi, it's a tough choice. They're both cute, they're both adorable, and they're both totally in love with Tadano! He's gonna have to make a very, VERY hard decision soon. I think we all can agree that he will end up with Komi, since this series is named after her and is mainly about her. Ah, to be young and in love. Such fond memories for me.

I love that there is a dream cast Good story. Kind of...somber? Not sure if that was the right word. She was upbeat and they had good times but there was an overall sadness about the book. Not a bad thing, just a thing. The Ian storyline seemed pointless to me, not sure what it was supposed to add to the story, it could be removed and nothing would change.

Omg everything about this book was beautiful! Pause Omg everything about this book was beautiful! Pause, not Dominic or that trifling cousin, but you know what I mean.

It was like spoken word. Poetically thugged out.
They were so good for each other! I'm just mad she kept that secret, and it's fasho bout to have Zu back in that effed up headspace. Heck, it's got me in a effed up headspace.

Rae and Zeek and Hope and Freak are hilarious.
I can't wait until the next

NoDoz in book form! I am more familiar with Gregg Olsen's true crime books but this is a novel I could not put down.  WOW!  He stitched this book together like an award-winning quilt.  One caveat:  don't read the last 5 or 10 chapters and then expect to get a good night's sleep.  This one held on to me and reluctantly let me go about 3:00 AM.
Great book This is a definite must reread. The whole series is amazing.. thriller, suspense,romance. Ivy writes the best books. She is an amazing author.
Interesting but not great The story was interesting, the characters moderately developed and an enjoyable read, but not real compelling to continue the series
Good book This was a good book had a little trouble getting through it the politics of the race were very interesting to read about

Sweet Cats I like how they had to in the old house for so long with it being so cold.
I liked that never gave trying to rich the kitten got itself stuck in the wall and was able to get freed from the wall.

So-so The story idea is a great; it's a truly good tale.... But it's told in such a long, boring (in places) way that I skim-read the first half of the book and several parts after that. This is a case of a new writer with tons of promise publishing his work before it was really ready.

Beautiful storyline This is just one of those books you don't want to put down. The characters are well developed and the story draws you in from start to finish. The writing is witty, lots of action and romance and I personally believe would make a great movie. Tanya Bird is an amazing author and I highly recommend this book and all of her books...
Relaxing Reading What I like about Danielle Steel books is that they draw you in within the first few pages and are a relaxing, easy, enjoyable read!

Inspirational This book would be an excellent read for young people  of high school and college age.  So many of them are bullied and ridiculed about the  appearance.  It is also excellent in pointing out that so often the parents bear responsibly.  The book is a bit "Pollyanna" in that losing weight doesn't mean you will become a beautiful swan, a supermodel, become rich, have the opposite sex drooling or gain revenge on an unfaithful, abusive lover or spouse.
love love love this too short story Kate is Kate in Wilmington or Atlanta or anywhere. She sees a problem and solves it no matter what it takes. Indomitable. Dear authors, please write faster.

Hannibal Jones - A Christmas story This is a short story for Hannibal Jones. He is too tired to make it home and stops off at a small motel. He notices strange behavior that leads him to solving the mystery. Had Hannibal not visited the motel that night, a mystery would have gone unsolved. I enjoyed reading this during the holiday season.
Pretty good. Much better than the first book. Of course I am constantly comparing to the series as I watch them. But better job.

I just don't know WHO to trust! Oh….my…. goodness…. That’s all I can say after finishing ‘Trust No Bitch 2” by Authors Nene Capri and Ca$h. Part two picks up right where part one left off.  I won’t go into detail because I don’t trust myself to not spoil a few twists lol, but I will say I cannot wait for part three to see how everything will play out. If I could give this book 100 stars I would. It was a banger!!! Grab your copy today!
This is a wild ride! Grabbed my attention immediately! First one I have read by Ernie Lindsey. Simply could not put it down! I just finished it and am looking at purchasing the rest of the series.
Book Thus book give  you a good idea of what women's prison is like, not many people talk about it or explain what goes on.

Made me want to read more books by Richard Phillips I can't recommend these books (Second Ship, Immune, and Wormhole) highly enough.  Mr. Phillips is highly qualified to write the technical portions of the books (physics, computers, and action sequences) and he creates characters that you care about and believe in.  Happy reading!

Whew!!!! Babbbbyyyyyyyy!!!!!! You wrote the hell out of this book!!!! Couldn't put it down!! From the first page to the last was action packed. I'm glad Bleu got her happily ever after, and that Tonya came to her senses.. That Isaiah was something TERRIBLE
Nice idea, a bit ponderous Nicely written novel, but the amount of detail becomes a bit ponderous.  I appreciate the author's knowledge, but a bit fewer details would help the novel flow better.

I'll love to see what the next book is about This story is fast paced and is interested enough to keep you reading but a little unbreakable.  How can these girls keep spiraling downward all the time?  I've known this author for a few years now and have enjoyed her books tremendously,  but the books are now leaning toward erotic.  Keep it clean or change the description to a higher heat level.

I don't know when the title was changed, but I am assuming this was the original title. I just looked it up, and found this title followed by the fact it is more commonly known by the title we now use which comes from the first line. The article also said this was first published anonymously in 1823 and later attributed to Clement Clarke Moore who claimed authorship in 1837. Intere
Oh yes Wow sizzling sex with cowboys along with a well written story and I'm entertained.  Loved this book. Oh yes and a happily ever after.

Should be required in every high school's curriculum. Well written, considering it was put into a book well over five hundred years ago. The outcome has been well known, but the sacrifices those men made are beyond modern day belief. It was spellbinding and horrifying at the same time.
Good read This was an easy read.  It read like a book that could eventually be a movie, it has some good espionage .  Got through it quickly.
Whodunit? The story line gave many suspects. Always nice so it keeps you guessing. I was wrong. You might be too! Have a read and enjoy!
A good read. A very good read. Accurate on actual historic events of the time in which the story takes place. Good plot and strong character development.
Nice Mystery involved Very well written.  Kept me reading throughout entire book.  Can’t imagine being in Ann’s shoes…what a horrific situation to have been in!!!

Loved these book and read several so far. Great characters too Great characters, loved all the books and have read several of them so far. I will read the rest, they are interesting, no gore, cuss words and are not real scary.
Good read for beach holiday! Even though a predictable story line, it was a charming setting with likable characters.  It was a feel good ,easy reading book!  Perfect for a relaxing beach get away!

Great suspenseful series I didn't write a review for every book in the series but now I think about it someone may see one of the other books then want to read a review. I truly love this whole series and have no complaints about any of the books in the series. If Melinda would ever write another book to this series I would definitely get on the band wagon to reading it and writing a review.

Loved this book I have loved every one of the books in this series.  Jessie knows how to take a character with flaws and bring them to a spiritual awakening or renewal and become closer to God.  I'm not a "beach" person but I find myself looking at beach life a little differently...thanks to Jessie and this series.

Interestong and sometimes even witty This book provides fascinating, detailed stories, written from the perspective of the 19th Century. I disagree that it is badly written, It's just written in the vernacular of it's day. Plus, there are several witty asides and comments on the antics and motivations of the protagonists that I thoroughly enjoyed. If it has any fault, for me, it's that it's narrative can get overly long in some places.

Hot Rock Star Keeping The Beat is book 3 in the Heart Beats series. I really enjoyed this book. This story is a second chance rock star book.

This book was a great read! It was a fun, fast read and the author has a good writing style. I love the characters in this book, and I thought Dylan and Claire had great chemistry. I can’t wait to read the next books in the series.

Overall I really enjoyed this story and would recommend it.
My review of the book of Matthew I love re-reading this first book of the NEw Testament.  I'll never master the pronunciation of the strange names they had however.
It was ok Really slow. Lots of character development but no real plot or twist. Good for a light read but easy to put down.
Great I love Holmes. I've been waiting for another story that includes him/her. This was really fun. I'm going to check out the rest of the series.
Speaks to me Eric LaRocca fiction is my jam!
Lost in a confused life A confused life for a young person which started at an early age. Obviously she followed a pattern of life that she was exposed to. A lesson to be learn.

Easy read. Love this book, just like all the other ones I have read from Jill Sanders. They are not easy to put down, they have sadness, happiness, funny and suspense all at the same time, and romance as well.
I would recommend her books to anyone who likes to read terrific, heartwarming books.
Fun, Fun, Fun Finally I know what Steampunk is. Had read several stories and seen some jewelry but hadn't put the two together. Now will be looking for more in the future.

Average I love stories of the sea and high adventure. This story was only ok. I like the Island and the inventions on it. I would love to live there myself! Jared is kind of annoying, the story has lots of cliches and some of the information was just plain wrong. With that said, I did read it all, and it was a pretty good idea.

Reads like it was written by a teenage girl. I thought it was awkward and formulaic.
I would recommend it for (surprise) teenage girls and did not finish it.

Haec Maga A magic adventure sets up presumed parameters and hints at the warmth of hidden affections. Readable with the occasional quotable lines! Of course one is drawn to read the next volumes and perhaps even to re-read this first book.

Is there more This got interesting real quick. For a story with not a lot details it was amazing. I also hoping there is more from River and Stephen. With the abrupt leaving from Stephen gets the story unfinished.

Will Emmie Be Found? What would it be like for parents to lose their child?

This book has so many emotions and fears, and I cannot wait
to read the next book, 0Dear Jack".
Jean Ehrhart This book shows small town America and also high school kids that are making the transition from kids to adults. It also tells the story of different kinds of families.
Loving this series! So far, I am loving this series!  It not only brings life to the historical events of King Hezekiah's time, but is a great faith-builder.

Pricing a bit of a ripoff Its a bit of a rip off to sell a 100 page book at this price. Clearly the author has cut up a regular novel into bite sized chunks and is selling them individually. Normally I could get one of the regular sized books for $10.00. I will end up paying $20 to buy it in pieces. Still, it is pleasant to read. I do a lot of travelling and use the Kindle in airports.
good story Took a while to fully develop. As soon as it did it was a read that was hard to put down.

What did I just read?! I am at a loss for words to review this novel.
I could not put it down, even though I wanted to at some points. I just couldn't tear myself away from it, or sleep after I read it.
I'm stunned. It lived up to all the hype, and then some.
Wow.

Good for the Correct Audience I think if you enjoy dark graphic novels, you will like this. I only tried it out because of the great word of mouth on it so i don't think I am the intended audience - I prefer more convensional story telling. But that doesn't mean that it wasn't good.
Ok Enjoyable juvenile but at least the story is not buried in reams of pseudo tech .  thank god does not seem to do a Clancy in his juveniles.

A bit different! The whole idea of "reverse harem" was very different but then why not...there was a purpose after all!
I did read book one and two!!

Enjoyable I enjoyed.  The main character and the dog were likable, but most of the characters were kinda shallow low life types.  I am not really into hearing about how much people drink and smoke (yawn).  It had a good little mystery going, and I didn't guess the ending.  But the characters were so boring, I had a hard time keeping them straight in my head from night to night (this was a good going to sleep book).  I finished it, so it entertained, and the price was very good(free).

#no More hashtags please!!!! It would have been MUCH better without the constant #hashtags. I just kept skipping over them, but they were a major distraction from the story. Plus, Maisey was all over the place, it felt like I was reading from a prepubescent teenagers stand point. Not a"21" year olds. The story itself needs fleshed out more.  The concept is an good one, it just needs more.

Its okay.. Its okay.. I dont feel like I learned anything that you don't already know from picking up on a few online articles. They just constantly repeat themselves over and over.. the book could be half the size if they didnt repeat so much.

Another breathholding book by James Patterson This book was great. I've been following the Cross family since the beginning. It's so cool to see little All grow up and wasn't to be just like his dad, the famous Alex Cross!!!!
Well Crafted. Witty and we'll crafted. Original storyline and kept your interest throughout.

Case Lee Somehow Prevails!! If you like the Case Lee series, don’t miss this one. Lots of action and do-Goode antics, plenty of mission impossible, and a nice dash of brothers - and a sister- in arms.

While these do stand alone, I think one is much better positioned for enjoyment by reading this series from the start. I now feel like I know all of the characters, the author’s character development is quite good.

Action, adventure, foreign locales, horrid bad guys, and did

Five for story three for editing Great story, plot fantastic as well as the characters.  Humor was spot on.  Now the only downside, editing.  In a word, bad.  Why did Jeremy's name change when he was promoted? Back to plusses, the references to Star Wars and Star Trek were great.  Biblical references spot on.  Expectantly waiting on next installment.

Good story I liked this mystery, and really enjoyed the interaction between Holmes and Watson. The mystery kept me guessing, and the style of writing kept it moving right along.

This is part of a series of books I do enjoy, but with they all had been edited better. This is better than the earlier books, but still needs a good editor to find those missing punctuation marks and some places where the wrong words have been used.
Get ready for a disturbed person. I started reading and could not stop. It was non-stop for the whole book. I normally don't read non-stop but you sort of get caught up in it.
Fun Time Travel Novel This book made me laugh and love the main character. She came alive on the pages. All the characters are interesting and will be fun to see how they develop in the series.

Another Phenomenal Story!! 🔥🔥 I swear from the very beginning of the book till the very last page I was in love with Alaric and Phoenix character!! They definitely complete one another. They needed each other to overcome their fears, pain, and love. I love love love their bickering. Phoenix does not hold back lol 😂 that’s my girl!! I hope we get books on the side characters....let’s see who will be next!!

Good, so far Just starting book.  So far so good.  Cindy Trimm is a great author.  Can't wait to finish the book.

Interesting read, makes you really think about the ugliness of war I really enjoyed reading this book, although the story wasn't necessarily a pleasant one. Then again, war isn't a pretty subject. y liked the way the author told the story, going back and forth between the past and present. It was sad and also quite intriguing how many lives were affected by the war in so many different ways. Love, loss, family relationships, all themes that came into play throughout the novel.

Lots of good, lots of not so good. Good for the price, that is sure. Lots of good stories here but the layout sort of suffers. Maybe I missed it but there didn't seem to be any index or table of contents included. It is sometimes hit or miss in picking out the better works (Kipling wrote lots and lots of it wasn't really all that good). Still, there is a lot to like in the collection. I just wished it were better organised.
Was okay Was a okay read
Sad! and Scary Very readable.  Some unexpected information, but nothing inconsistent with what was able to be gleaned from OUTSIDE the White House.

I wanted to like this book I don't know why I didn't enjoy this.  The writing is fairly good.  I just was not invested in the characters, at all.  The protagonist's detachment from his wife seemed juvenile and angsty.  Not the book for me, I guess.
Classic one of my fav books of all time, can't believe they haven't made a movie out of it. So funny and clever, the main character is so unlikeable!

Great ending to the series Loved the turn of events in Zephyr and Maria's story.  If it were so easy to bring peace we would all be happy and able to live in peace.  My only question is what will all those dragons do on earth?

WOW Well DANG.

Didn’t see any of that coming! I have to say that I was surprised. A good, quick read!
Great read. I completely enjoys the book, But it seems to leave a few loose ends, and I don't believe there is another one in the series coming out. So whats a person to do!
A little too much Started off good then just got repetitious and confusing. However I appreciate that the author tried something different so props for that.

adventure with murder and mayhem This story is one which builds into an epic about a very adept swindler who uses the spirit world of departed lost souls to stir up various communities to pay the spirits to move on. Such a flimflam has been used to fleece citizens many times over the years.  On this occasion a number of people were killed, one being the minister of the local church who was much loved and respected. This story runs much longer than necessary, mostly by being too wordy when expres
Cute This was a cute book.  It was just what I needed. The storyline was a little predictable but I enjoyed the book. It was an easy read.  I will read others by this author.

A good book. I really enjoyed this book. It was interesting and the story different. There is romance, family,relationships between five people. There is a teenager who is wise beyond her years, a delightful young lady. The adults become good friends and the story begins. You'll enjoy this book.

Somebody should shake the hell outta Zee Like sis what is even your problem? I enjoyed this book but it definitely could have used some fleshing out of feelings and thoughts. Or maybe Zee just didn’t actually know what her feelings were that’s why they were never made clear. Which was really frustrating. So the dates and the concept was cute but I was way to annoyed for way to much of this story. Not my favorite obviously but I still love me some Rilzy Adams.

Home is from the heart Maya is content with her life until the day she finds out there is much more than she knew. Luke finally feels it's time to let Maya know she is his mate and sees it all crumble apart.  This story grabs you by the throat as these two travel the road of discovering who they are and what home means.

A pleasant surprise! This was my first book by Debbi Mack, and I'm always a little leary of of $.99 Kindle books, but this was a pleasant surprise!  The book is well-written and the character development of Sam McRue was well done.  Least Wanted kept me interested in the plot, and now I'm looking for more books by Debbi Mack.
Short easy read I wasn't expecting much. There is no fluff. It gets to the point and covers all the points. Some examples/screenshots, tables would have been useful.
Fascinating! Another fascinating story by this brilliant author.
Cute holiday romance I really enjoyed this book, the main characters were adorable and I loved how they went from neighbors to more. Worth the read!
Great book for any kid! My autistic 8 yo son has difficulty recognizing nuances and regulating his emotions. Ms. Ortega’s books quickly became regular reading for us.

Outstanding! A poignant visit into a world that is entirely possible.
This is a story of an act of betrayal, for geopolitical reasons, against the rest of humanity. What is left is a collect of chosen survivors collected into 50 colonies. This book is an accounting of one of those colonies. It is a well written and thought provoking tale with characters to root for and against.

An excellent 2nd techno thriller with a dash of SciFi The author has hit a home run again. Plot was developed and the twists were pretty well hidden. Another entertaining and well written story from this great author. If you haven’t read his works in the past, pick this one up!!!  If you have, this is a great follow on read. Long live space opera and techno thrillers!!

Great third in the series, but still some questions Loved all three books in this series.  Written from a first person perspective, which fits the character absolutely perfectly.  A bit of a letdown at the end - not knowing what will come of everyone, especially our "hero".  Will there be a next one?  What happens after or on Alcatraz?

Notorious Oh my gosh! What a fantastic journey! I didn't want to put this book down and fell asleep in the early morning hours reading. The characters are wonderful, interesting and engaging. I love the banter between Dru and Gabriel I really didn't want this book to end. It is one of the beat books that I have read. I look forward to reading the next book in this series. Magnífico Otro magnífico, intrigante, estupendo libro de la colección del detective Morles. Me encantan todos los libros del detective Morles, intriga de principio a fin. Me alegra mucho encontrar nuevamente un nuevo libro del magnífico autor Miguel Ángel Itriago. Deseo que siga escribiendo sus maravillosos libros, uno de mis autores favoritos.

The 1984 of our generation... This could be the most terrifying book I've ever read...because so much of what's in this work of "fiction" is already happening...Facebook, Twitter, drones, cameras in every public place...and more...

Dave Eggers is brilliant, and this was un-put-downable!

Not a mystery I went into this blind, I didn't read more than a few lines of the synopsis.  Overall, it was an enjoyable book but nothing great.  I kind of figured from the start the plot twist was going to be once the one twin disappeared.  Then I didn't even notice the last twist at the end at first.  Now that I read a couple reviews the ending/twist I get.
Interesting insight into the time and travel adventure I read  this each night for 30minutes or so before dropping off to sleep.  It was a light adventure we'll told.
A love story at it’s best The novella is another winner! The scene of Montana’s last night on stage brought tears to my eyes. The author packed a lot of substance into just a few pages.
Unspeakable crimes It was difficult to put down. Unbelievably deceitful mother who had such control over her children, husband and friends.  Great writing.

Ready for the Next in the Series It is rather disconcerting that both the good and evil characters pray. Otherwise, this was a good book. Toward the end it was a page turner and ended with a cliffhanger. The parts about the white leopard were cute and so well described whenever it was mentioned.
Really like Faith Martin's way of spinning a story Really like Faith Martin's way of spinning a story.  Her people involved with the plots begin to be a have neighborly way of being worked together.
riveting This book took all of my attention from page 1. The hell these people have to go through day to day is incredible. Well written and makes you appreciate our men in the service.

Wow what a book! Ariana is the princess that life like the way she wanted having fun! Then she realized it was time to make a difference.
Jameson grew up in a family who worried more about power then worried about their son. He decided he's going to serve his country.
After a mission goes wrong his mother interfere in his life.
Now it's his job to keep Dignitaries safe That's when he meets Ari. Oh Kathleen has hit this book out of the park! This is a book of strength and change if

Fun I really enjoyed the book. I love a good chic lit novel and this good one funny,cute,and romantic
I will be reading more of her books.

Limbus is back Limbus is back with even more perfect jobs for you. While this is set in the same world I didn't enjoy it as much as I did the first one. I thin I spent too much time comparing it to the first anthology that I just couldn't get into this one. Not that the stories were bad, I just didn't enjoy them as much.

If they do another anthology I know I'll read that one too.

Not his best work Usually love John Grisham books but this was not his best work. Didn’t care much for the plot or how it played out plus it left some things completely unanswered so overall a bit disappointed.

I think I feel even more in love with the night keepers in this one. Phenomenal writing and story/world building.

Realistic couple Loved the storyline of two very good childhood friends who meet up twenty years later. Believable, funny and good cookie along the way. Did I start to write and they....nope, you need to read the book

Maiden or Bride This book in the series features Anna Mae and her family.  We follow as she b comes a very capable adult as she cares for first one sister, then all 5 of her siblings?  Will she devote herself to them as or will keep them, but still find her own happiness and love to.
Love those little bursts of goodness! Very informative,but would have liked more recipes using them because it's hard to know how to get the most out of them.
Host with the most I really appreciate  what Tyler went through growing up. The rags to riches story of a beloved comic is truly  miraculous.
